package.name: sensor_bridges
package.description: Publishes our actual sensors (Livox Mid-360 over raw UDP, OAK-D-Lite via DepthAI) as standard ROS2 topics (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2, sensor_msgs/Image) so ros2_camera_lidar_fusion -- which expects those, not a specific driver -- can run against our hardware without a livox_ros_driver2 or depthai-ros build.
